race.description: Procon Development (Aust) Northam Cup 25 Oct Mdn
race.comment: KEPPEL GATE (8) earns top billing after a sound debut third at this track, where she began awkwardly on heavy ground, covered ground and still worked home well enough to find the frame. She was near the top of betting there and she's been given some time between runs. Can get the job done this time. CLEAR ASSAULT (7) showed good ability on debut at this track, missing by a neck when in he market. Winkers go on now and she's readied for this with a recent trial. Down in the weights and can resume with a forward showing. COASTAL DREAM (10) was just fair in her first trial, but improved quickly in the break, winning her latest heat in readiness for this. Fiore rides and she can feature prominently. CACHACA (1) lands here third-up after sticking on nicely over 1100m last start. Can improve with the rise in trip and won't be far away. BUSTER'S BABE (6) has trialled nicely coming into this and can play a leading role on debut.
